title: Messages Aria Expanded
prompt: A React messages disclosure needs an aria-expanded string. Write a helper that returns "true" when expanded is true and "false" when expanded is false.

explanation.beginner:
Example: messagesAriaExpanded(true) produces "true". Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Compare “returns false string”: input [false] produces "false". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Tempting mistake: Capitalization, whitespace, and boolean-versus-string output are part of the contract; truthiness alone may combine distinct states.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “returns false string”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
